# Implementation review: fn-3-focus-mode-agent-notification-summary.1 (round 5)

<verdict>SHIP</verdict>

The exclusive flock wraps every `focus.json` load/merge/write, including picker and `--set` paths. Claude isolation keeps empty cwd and private `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` separate, copies only `.credentials.json`, and uses one complete auth route with incomplete `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` (no `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`) falling through. Grok home is private 0700, `auth.json` 0600, and contains only `auth.json` plus the controlled `config.toml`. `invoke_summary_agent("grok")` proves once via `_grok_proven`. `Popen` + `start_new_session` + `os.killpg` covers the timeout path.

No remaining findings against task `.1` acceptance, Touches, or R5/R7/R8/R11/R12/R13.
